title: Effects of Pramlintide on Endogenous Production of Very-low-density-lipoprotein (VLDL)-Triglyceride and Glucose in the Post Prandial State in T2DM
brief_summary: Diabetes affects almost 21 million people in the United States. In this study we will test a drug called Pramlintide(Symlin), and see how it works to lower blood sugar and fat levels after a meal. Lowering high sugar levels and fat levels after a meal is very important in the prevention of the problems that persons with type 2 diabetes often encounter. Hypothesis is that Pramlintide will lower blood sugar and fat levels after a meal.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 DM study participants will be C-Peptide positive (levels \> 0.3 nmol/L)
* Receiving insulin, metformin and/or sulfonylurea/glitinide.
* Maintained on stable anti-hypertensive medication.
* BMI \< 52 kg/m2.
* T2DM for at least 3 months with HBA1C under 10%.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Receiving TZDs, exenatide, sitagliptin or pramlintide therapy.
* Receiving medications known to impair gastric emptying, intestinal motility, glucagon release or corticosteroids.
* Triglyceride levels \> 400 mg/dl.
* BMI \> 52 kg/m2.
